agendaItems.title:
File No. CM26-25891
Abbye Feeley, Administrator of Development & Economic Opportunity, Michael Perry, Deputy Chief Financial Officer, and their respective team members to present the findings of the Raftelis Fee Study for Construction Services, Development Coordination, and Historic Preservation, including the study’s full cost recovery analysis; provide a summary of the public input received during the August 18, 2026, community meeting; and facilitate a discussion regarding a balanced, multi-year strategy for Council’s consideration to right-size the City’s fees, including identifying fees appropriate for movement toward cost recover and those that should remain below full cost recovery in recognition of their broader public benefit. (Original motion initiated by Hurtak-Miranda on July 16, 2026)
Memorandum from JC Hudgison, Chief Building Official/Construction Services Manager, and Michael D. Perry, Deputy Chief Financial Officer, transmitting a written report and a PowerPoint presentation for said agenda item. (To be R/F)
